provenance.rights_note: Dante's own edit (higgsfield_content_factory_v3_DISCOVERY.mp4), accepted 2026-10-24 ('beautiful job well done'). Values come from the compositor that rendered it; see STYLE-HIGGSFIELD-V3.md.

pacing.min_pause_s.note: v3 QC gate max internal pause 0.35 s; longest kept pause 0.34 s (codex-handoff C4).

pacing.pad_s.note: v3 kept 80 ms after each decay tail (hf_render_v3.py:13 EDL; C2). FRAME pads ASR word times, not energy onsets, so this is an approximation.

pacing.remove_retakes.note: v3 used one chosen take per line; raw single-clip footage needs retake removal to get the same result.

captions.y.note: v3 full-frame caption centre y=1220 of 1920 (hf_render_v3.py:58).

captions.size.note: v3 caption text 66 px on a 1920 px frame (hf_render_v3.py FC=font(66,'Heavy')).

captions.emphasis_color.note: #E2FD56 sampled from Higgsfield's own UI for the v3 edit (HANDOFF.md 3.3).

captions.font.note: v3 used SF Pro Heavy/Black, which FRAME does not offer; Inter Black is the nearest available. Needs Dante's OK.
